dip = revenue.index[8]
ax.annotate(
    "September dip",
    xy=(dip, revenue[dip]),
    xytext=(revenue.index[9], 108),
    arrowprops={"arrowstyle": "->"})
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
    "${x:.0f}k")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
